content_text: Hello, I was looking for lighting critiques for this image I made awhile ago as I want to hone in on methods of lighting such as using controlled ambient lighting with practicals as I did in the image here with this only having top fluorescent tubes through a plastic screen, a lamp to the side, and festive lights in the background. The goal was to create something comforting but ominous and moody at the same time and I had much more grand plans but as per the contest I wanted to submit this in on time I had to go with whatever I could do so there’s that. I’d love to hear your thoughts.
